cc:Work.dc:description: Linear verification. (a) Off-chain admission and aggregate verification using commitments and signatures versus BLS signatures and reaggregation. (b) Proposed admissions and result submission (output digest and commitment). Means with sample SD from 100 pairs in (a) and five full cases in (b).
